chunks: From him, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Ḥakīm, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The woman experiencing istiḥāḍah exercises precaution for one day or two days.

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she exercises precaution by waiting or adding a precautionary period

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about how long a woman with istiḥāḍah should exercise precaution?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah. It states that she should observe precaution for one or two days, indicating a juristic guideline in matters of menstrual and non-menstrual bleeding.
